svg.title: t narrow 24
svg.desc: 24 simultaneous robots at a t junction with a 1-cell crossing and three-cell aisles. Every route crosses the center and ends in a private side bay.

g.text: 24 robots · 1-cell crossing · three-cell aisles · private parking bays

g.text: Filled circle: robot ID · G: parking goal · yellow: conflict zone · small gray dot: port
All robots initially face north. Colors identify the origin arm, including at destinations.
